item.title: How Aurora Adaptive Threat Protection Detects, Stops, and Reverses Modern Attacks
item.dc:creator: Arctic Wolf
item.description: Aurora Adaptive Threat Protection helps security teams stop modern attacks that evade traditional endpoint defenses. Instead of relying on a single malicious event, Aurora Adaptive Threat Protection continuously tracks endpoint activity, connects related behaviors into a complete attack story, and disrupts attacks the moment malicious intent is detected.

item.title: Human-in-the-Loop (HITL)
item.dc:creator: Arctic Wolf
item.description: What Is Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) AI? Human-in-the-loop (HITL) AI refers to any artificial intelligence system or process that integrates meaningful human participation at critical stages of how the AI learns, makes decisions, or acts.
